lleglaris0.m: Are you sure you should be here? Maybe you should go play with ... your toys or something?
r: Watch it. Do you even know who you're talking to?
Hey, no need to be rude.
Hey, those look like some nice items you have there. Care to trade?

lleglaris1.m: Ha ha. I can be as rude as I want!
r: Watch it. Do you even know who you're talking to?

lleglaris11.m: I saw this hole in the ground that they seemed to come out of. The ground had been completely corrupted around it.

lleglaris12.m: Anyway, I ran away and my amulet must have gotten stuck on a branch or something like that.
r: I'll go look for your amulet.

lleglaris13.m: Yeah, that's what I though as well.

lleglaris15.m: Go look just east of my cabin here. You probably need to take the path north when you exit the cabin, and then head east.

r: I was the one who slew the lich Toszylae between Loneford and Brimhaven.
See this amulet that I'm wearing? This is Marrowtaint.
See this ring that I am wearing? This is the Ring of lesser Shadow.
I was the one who helped solve the mystery in Loneford.
I saved the settlement of Prim from the attacks from Blackwater mountain.
I helped the Blackwater mountain settlement make the attacks from Prim stop.
I am the son of an ordinary farmer in a minor settlement called Crossglen, not far west from here! I've even killed a rat or two!

lleglaris3.m: That was you? Hah! And you expect me to believe that?

lleglaris4.m: Good for you. It looks just like any other trinket to me.

lleglaris6.m: You have my best wishes, kid. Hope you'll get to see the world some day.

lleglaris7.m: If you're such an experienced adventurer, I'm sure a small task of mine wouldn't be any problem for you?

lleglaris8.m: I've lost an amulet of mine. I was out in the woods around the cabin here and heard a noise coming from the east.

lleglaris9.m: Tired as I was, I didn't notice the things coming out from behind the trees fast enough.

lleglaris_r1.m: Hi again. Did you find my amulet?
r: Can you tell me your story again?

lleglaris_r2.m: OK then. I won't keep you.

lleglaris_r3.m: Yes, that's the one. It's good to see it back in my hands again.

lleglaris_r4.m: Thank you for finding my amulet.

lleglaris_r5.m: Maybe you really are an experienced adventurer after all.

lleglaris_r6.m: Anyway, see this table here? It's just some old trinkets that I've gathered along the years. Maybe some of them could come in handy for you?
r: Let me see what you have.

lleglaris_rej.m: With you? No way. You look way to inexperienced.
r: Watch it. Do you even know who you're talking to?

loneford.10: I heard a story about Loneford. Apparently, a lot of people have become ill there recently, and some have even died. The cause is still unknown.
loneford.11: I should investigate what could have caused the people of Loneford to become ill. To gather clues, I should ask the citizens of Loneford and the surrounding areas about what they think is the cause.
loneford.21: The guards in the Crossroads guardhouse are certain that the illness in Loneford is caused by some sabotage done by the priests or people from Nor City.
loneford.22: Some villagers in Loneford believe that the illness is caused by the guards from Feygard, in some scheme to make the people suffer even more than they already have.
loneford.23: Talion, the chapel priest in Loneford, thinks that the illness is the work of the Shadow, as punishment for Loneford's lack of devotion to the Shadow.
loneford.24: Taevinn in Loneford is certain that Sienn in the southeast barn has something to do with the illness. Apparently, Sienn keeps a pet around that has approached Taevinn in a threatening manner several times.
loneford.25: I should go see Landa in the Loneford tavern. Rumor has it that he saw something that he doesn't dare tell anyone.
loneford.30: Landa confused me with someone else at first. He apparently saw a boy doing something around the town well during the night before the illness started. He was scared to talk to me at first since he thought I looked like the boy he had seen. Could it have been Andor that he saw?
loneford.31: Also, the night after he saw the boy at the well, he saw Buceth taking samples of the water in the well. Strangely enough, Buceth has not gotten ill like the others in the village.
loneford.35: I should go question Buceth at the Loneford chapel about what he was doing at the well, and about whether he knows anything about Andor.
loneford.41: I have bribed Buceth into talking to me.
loneford.42: I have told Buceth that I am ready to follow the Shadow.
loneford.45: Buceth tells me that he is assigned by the priests in Nor City to make sure the Shadow casts its glow over Loneford. Apparently, the priests had sent a boy to do some business in Loneford, and Buceth was tasked with gathering some samples from the water well.
loneford.50: I have attacked Buceth. I should bring any evidence that Buceth has on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in the longhouse in Loneford.
loneford.54: I have given the vial that Buceth had on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in Loneford.
loneford.55: Kuldan thanked me for solving the mystery of the illness in Loneford. They will start bringing in water with help from Feygard instead of drinking from the well from now on. Kuldan also told me to visit the castle steward in Feygard if I want to help further.
loneford.60: I have promised to keep Buceth's story a secret. If Andor was indeed here, he must have had a good reason for doing what he did. Buceth also told me to visit the chapel custodian in Nor City if I want to learn more about the Shadow.

toszylae.10: On the road between Loneford and Brimhaven, I found a dried up lake-bed with a major cavern below. Deep inside the cavern, I met Ulirfendor - a priest of the Shadow from Brimhaven. Ulirfendor is trying to translate the inscriptions on a shrine of Kazaul, and has determined that it speaks of the 'Dark protector', but he is unsure what that refers to. Whatever it means, he is determined that it must be stopped.
toszylae.11: Ulirfendor needs help with figuring out what some of the missing parts on the shrine says. The inscription reads 'Kulauil hamar urum Kazaul'te', but the next parts have been completely eroded from the rock.
toszylae.15: I have agreed to help Ulirfendor find out what the missing parts of the inscription might be. Ulirfendor believes the shrine speaks of a powerful creature that lives deeper inside the dungeon. Maybe that could provide some clue as to what the missing parts are.
toszylae.20: Deep inside the dungeon, I encountered a radiant guardian, guarding some other being. The guardian uttered the phrases 'Kulauil hamar urum Kazaul'te. Kazaul hamat urul'. This must be what Ulirfendor was looking for. I should return to him at once.
toszylae.21: I tried to attack the guardian, but was unable to even reach it. Some powerful force held me back. Maybe Ulirfendor knows more.
toszylae.30: Ulirfendor was very pleased to hear that I uncovered the missing parts of the inscription.
toszylae.32: He also told me the continuation of the inscription, but did not know what it means. I should go back to the guardian and speak the words that Ulirfendor told me.
toszylae.42: I have spoken the words to the guardian.
toszylae.45: The guardian gave off a chilling laughter, and started attacking me.
toszylae.50: I defeated the guardian and reached the lich 'Toszylae'. The lich managed to infect me with something. I must kill the lich and return to Ulirfendor.
toszylae.60: Ulirfendor told me that he had managed to translate the parts of the inscription that I told the guardian. Apparently, what I told the guardian roughly means 'My body for Kazaul'. Ulirfendor was very concerned about what this means for me, and was very regretful that he had made me speak the words.
toszylae.70: Ulirfendor was very happy to hear that I managed to defeat the lich. With the lich defeated, the people in the surrounding areas should be safe now.

prim_hunt.10: Just outside the collapsed mine on the way to Blackwater mountain, I met a man from the village of Prim. He begged me to help them.
prim_hunt.11: The village of Prim needs help from someone from the outside to deal with attacks from some monsters. I should speak to Guthbered in Prim if I want to help them.
prim_hunt.15: Guthbered can be found in the main hall of Prim. I should look for a stone house in the center of town.
prim_hunt.20: I talked to Guthbered about the story about Prim. Prim has recently been under constant attack from the Blackwater mountain settlement.
prim_hunt.25: Guthbered wants me to go up to the settlement atop the Blackwater mountain and ask their battle master Harlenn why (or if) they have summoned the gornaud monsters against Prim.
prim_hunt.30: I have talked to Harlenn about the attacks on Prim. He denies that the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement have anything to do with them. I should go talk to Guthbered in Prim again.
prim_hunt.40: Guthbered still believes that the people in the Blackwater mountain settlement have something to do with the attacks.
prim_hunt.50: Guthbered wants me to go look for any clues that the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement is preparing for a larger attack on Prim. I should go look for hints near Harlenn's private quarters, but make sure not to be seen.
prim_hunt.60: I have found some papers around Harlenn's private quarters outlining a plan to attack Prim. I should go talk to Guthbered immediately.
prim_hunt.70: Guthbered thanked me for helping him find evidence of the plans for an attack.
prim_hunt.80: In order to make the attacks on Prim stop, Guthbered wants me to kill Harlenn up in the Blackwater mountain settlement.
prim_hunt.90: I have started a fight with Harlenn.
prim_hunt.91: I told Harlenn that I was sent to kill him, but I let him live. He thanked me deeply, and left the settlement.
prim_hunt.99: I have told Guthbered that Harlenn is gone.
prim_hunt.100: Guthbered thanked me for the help I have provided to Prim. Hopefully, the attacks on Prim should stop now. As thanks, Guthbered gave me some items and a forged permit so that I can enter the inner chamber up in the Blackwater mountain settlement.
prim_hunt.140: I have shown the forged permit to the guard and was let through to the inner chamber.
prim_hunt.240: I am now trusted in Prim, and all services should be available for me to use.
prim_hunt.250: I have decided to not help the people of Prim.
prim_hunt.251: Since I am helping the Blackwater mountain settlement, Guthbered no longer wants to talk to me.

bwm_agent.1: I met a man seeking help for his settlement, the 'Blackwater mountain'. Supposedly, his settlement is being attacked by monsters and bandits, and they need help from the outside.
bwm_agent.5: I have agreed to help the man and Blackwater mountain in dealing with the problem.
bwm_agent.10: The man told me to meet him on the other side of the collapsed mine. He will crawl through the mine shaft and I will descend into the pitch-black abandoned mine.
bwm_agent.20: I have navigated through the pitch-black abandoned mine, and met the man on the other side. He seemed very anxious about telling me to head straight to the east once I exit the mine. I should meet the man at the bottom of the mountain to the east.
bwm_agent.25: I heard a story about Prim and the Blackwater mountain settlement fighting against each other.
bwm_agent.30: I should follow the mountain path up the mountain to the Blackwater mountain settlement.
bwm_agent.40: I met the man again on my way up to Blackwater mountain. I should proceed further up the mountain.
bwm_agent.50: I have made it up to the snow-filled parts of the Blackwater mountain. The man told me to proceed further up the mountain. Apparently, the Blackwater mountain settlement is close by.
bwm_agent.60: I have reached the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should find and talk to their battle master, Harlenn.
bwm_agent.65: I have spoken to Harlenn in the Blackwater mountain settlement. Apparently, the settlement is under attack by a number of monsters, the aulaeth and white wyrms. On top of that, they are being attacked by the people of Prim.
bwm_agent.66: Harlenn thinks the people of Prim are behind the monster attacks somehow.
bwm_agent.70: Harlenn wants me to give a message to Guthbered of Prim. Either the people of Prim stop their attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement, or they will have to be dealt with themselves. I should go talk to Guthbered in Prim.
bwm_agent.80: Guthbered denies that the people of Prim have anything to do with the monster attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn.
bwm_agent.90: Harlenn is sure that the people of Prim are behind the attacks somehow.
bwm_agent.95: Harlenn wants me to go to Prim and look for signs that they are preparing for an attack on the settlement. I should go look for clues around where Guthbered stays.
bwm_agent.100: I have found some plans in Prim about recruiting mercenaries and attacking the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn immediately.
bwm_agent.110: Harlenn thanked me for investigating the attack plans.
bwm_agent.120: To make the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement stop, Harlenn wants me to assassinate Guthbered in Prim.
bwm_agent.130: I have started a fight with Guthbered.
bwm_agent.131: I told Guthbered that I was sent to kill him, but I let him live. He thanked me deeply, and left Prim.
bwm_agent.149: I have told Harlenn that Guthbered is gone.
bwm_agent.150: Harlenn thanked me for the help I have provided. Hopefully, the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement should stop now.
bwm_agent.240: I am now trusted in the Blackwater mountain settlement, and all services should be available for me to use.
bwm_agent.250: I have decided to not help the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement.
bwm_agent.251: Since I am helping Prim, Harlenn no longer wants to talk to me.

lleglaris.10: In a cabin just off the Duleian road northwest of the Foaming Flask tavern, I met a man called Lleglaris. He wants me to retrieve an amulet that he has lost.
lleglaris.15: The amulet can be found in a cave infested with undead to the east of his cabin. He said something about the ground having been corrupted around that cave. I don't know what he meant.
lleglaris.30: I have given the amulet back to Lleglaris.
lleglaris.40: As thanks, Lleglaris offered to trade some of his items with me.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
